tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.

Those two statements come from Muninn decisions #22 ("verification on all builds") and #25 ("https everywhere, no exceptions"). The earlier decision that #22 replaced is retired, so I left it out, as you asked.

Muninn's session context also carried a "plain http for internal hosts" note. It is an earlier episode, and #25 is newer and says no exceptions, so I didn't include it.

The Muninn heartbeat flagged that 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate; `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` is where to look.
